# CANDIDATE: BULLISH_RECLAIM_10AM_WINDOW_GATE

**Filed:** 2026-07-18
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9) -- PENDING_GRADUATION

## Hypothesis

The BULLISH_RECLAIM setup exhibits strong time-of-day dependency, with win rates of 40-42% in the 10:00-11:00 ET and 12:00-13:00 ET windows, significantly higher than other morning windows (09:35-10:00: 18%, 11:00-12:00: 17%, 13:00-14:00: 12%). Restricting entries to these high-win-rate windows is expected to improve the overall win rate of the setup once it graduates to live trading.

## Mechanism

When the flag `block_bull_10am_window` is set to True (which will occur only after BULLISH_RECLAIM graduates to live trading with 3+ live wins), the engine will evaluate the time of day for any BULLISH_RECLAIM trigger. Entries will only be allowed if the trigger time falls within 10:00-11:00 ET or 12:00-13:00 ET. Triggers outside these windows will be blocked, resulting in no entry for the BULLISH_RECLAIM setup.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline
2. **Sample bias:** The provided WR numbers (40-42%, 18%, etc.) are from an unspecified analysis; sample size and selection method unknown. High overfit risk if derived from the same data used to propose the gate.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window tested)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no real-fills check on top 3 J days for BULLISH_RECLAIM with this gate)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Missing a strong bullish move outside allowed windows (e.g., 09:35-10:00 or 13:00-14:00) could turn a potential winner into a missed opportunity.
   - Max drawdown: Consecutive losses within allowed windows could increase drawdown if the gate fails to filter losing trades.
   - Blow-up scenario: If the allowed windows exhibit a regime shift to low win rate (e.g., due to volatility changes), the strategy could suffer sustained losses.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to determine if top-5 days of BULLISH_RECLAIM concentrate in the allowed windows.

## Pre-merge gate

- BULLISH_RECLAIM must graduate to live trading (achieve 3+ live wins) before this gate can be enabled.
- Stage-1 backtest of BULLISH_RECLAIM with the time window gate must show:
   - No regression on J anchor days (edge_capture unchanged or improved)
   - Improved win rate in the allowed windows vs. blocked windows
   - Passage of OP-20 gates (real-fills, OOS, etc.) for the BULLISH_RECLAIM setup with this gate
